daily-tally.title: Daily Tally
list.discard.confirm-message: In-progress tally data will be removed. This cannot be undone.
list.discard.cant-delete: Only in-progress drafts can be deleted.
config.import-export.help: Import or export the full configuration as a JSON file. Imported values replace the current form — Save to persist them.
config.import-export.loaded: Configuration loaded — review and Save to apply
config.import-export.invalid-shape: doesn't look like a Daily Tally configuration (expected an object with demographic_groups / non_vaccine_items / summary_tables / wastage_reasons)
config.groups.help: Tick the doses each demographic group is tallied for. Select a group to edit its counters, unit and summary header on the right.
config.group.empty: Select a group on the left to edit its counters and summary header.
config.group.label: Group label
config.group.unit-help: Noun after the running total in the workflow, e.g. “12 doses” / “12 women”.
config.group.summary-label-help: Column header for this group in the Step 3 coverage summary. Defaults to the group label.
config.group.counters-heading: Counters — Step 1 breakdown (shared by all this group's doses)
config.group.no-doses: None yet — tick cells in the matrix.
config.counter.label: Label
config.matrix.no-doses: No vaccine course doses found. Configure vaccine courses and their doses elsewhere in the app first — they become the columns here.
config.dose-order.help: Drag doses, or use the arrows, to set the single order they appear in across every demographic group, for both the Step 1 entry form and the Step 3 summary. A group that isn't assigned a dose simply skips it, keeping the rest in this order.
config.dose-order.empty: No doses assigned to any group yet. Assign doses on the Demographic groups tab first.
config.summary.heading: Summary tables
config.summary.help: Defines the Step 3 coverage summary. Each table's columns are demographic groups — pick them below. A column header uses the group's summary header, or its name when none is set.
config.non-vaccine.help: Items offered in the Step 2 Non-vaccine items section that aren't linked to a vaccine via an ancillary item (e.g. notebooks, non-medical supplies). Ancillary-linked supplies (syringes, safety boxes…) are added automatically at tally time and don't need listing here.
config.wastage.heading: Wastage reasons
config.wastage.help: These reason codes are stamped onto the negative inventory adjustments the workflow creates at submission — one per wasted batch. Open vial wastage applies to vaccine items; the negative inventory adjustment reason covers non-vaccine wastage.
detail.error.date-required: A valid session date is required
detail.duplicate-warning: A daily tally of type '{{type}}' already exists for this date.
detail.no-config: No Daily Tally configuration found. Set up the plugin configuration in Manage → Plugins before the page can render.
submit.title: Submit Daily Tally?
submit.summary.with-wastage: {{prescriptions}} and {{adjustments}} ({{doses}} doses wasted) will be recorded.
submit.error.adjustments-posted: {{count, number}} wastage adjustment(s) were already recorded (invoice number(s) {{numbers}}) and cannot be reversed. Remove the matching wastage entries before resubmitting to avoid recording them twice.
submit.preflight.wastage-config: Wastage reason options are missing from the plugin configuration. An administrator must set the {{reasons}} reason id(s) before this tally's wastage can be submitted.
submit.preflight.stock-exceeded: Issued or wasted quantities exceed available stock — reduce the figures (stock may have changed since you started):
submit.preflight.no-prescription-permiss: You do not have permission to create prescriptions.
submit.preflight.no-stocktake-permission: You do not have permission to record inventory adjustments.
submit.preflight.no-patient-permission: You do not have permission to create patient records.
submit.preflight.no-counts: No coverage counts have been entered.
batch.error: Failed to load batch data. Check the network tab for details.
batch.banner.stock-over-one: Exceeds available stock by {{doses}} dose — introduce stock before continuing
batch.banner.stock-over-many: Exceeds available stock by {{doses}} doses — introduce stock before continuing
batch.banner.stock-over-unit: Exceeds available stock by {{quantity}} {{unit}} — introduce stock before continuing
batch.banner.why.multiple-products: This course has more than one product in stock.
batch.banner.why.multiple-batches: This product has more than one batch in stock.
batch.non-vaccine.heading: Non-vaccine items
batch.non-vaccine.reminder: Don't forget: Check for damaged syringes, broken safety boxes, and wasted supplies
summary.load-error: Failed to load summary data. Check the network tab for details.
summary.heading: Stock movement summary
summary.empty: No configured items found for this tally.
summary.no-tables: No summary tables configured. Add a summary_tables section to the plugin configuration to see coverage roll-ups here.
summary.prescriptions.heading: Prescriptions
